Name: ofds_id
Title: Local identifier
Description: A local identifier for this organisation. The identifier must be unique within the scope of the `organisations` array.

Name: identifier__id
Title: Organisation identifier Identifier
Description: An organisation identifier. The identifier assigned to the organisation in the register identified in `.scheme`.

Name: identifier__scheme
Title: Organisation identifier Scheme
Description: An organisation identifier. The register from which the identifier in `.id` is drawn, from the open [organisationIdentifierScheme codelist](https://open-fibre-data-standard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/codelists.html#organisationidentifierscheme).

Name: identifier__legalName
Title: Organisation identifier Legal name
Description: An organisation identifier. The legally registered name of the organisation

Name: identifier__uri
Title: Organisation identifier URI
Description: An organisation identifier. A canonical URI for this identifier, such as those provided by Open Corporates. Do not use this field to provide the website of the organisation: instead, use `Organisation.website`.

Name: country
Title: Country
Description: The country in which this organisation is legally registered, from the closed [country codelist](https://open-fibre-data-standard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/codelists.html#country).

Name: roleDetails
Title: Role details
Description: Further details about this organisation's roles in the network

Name: website
Title: Website
Description: The URL of the website for this organisation.

Name: logo
Title: Logo
Description: The URL of the logo for this organisation.
